versions.content: On start of FreezeFrame sequence, the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall call the Dem_J1939DcmSetFreezeFrameFilter with the parameters ‘ FreezeFrameKind’ defined by the DMx message that triggered the sequence, as well as the assigned ‘DemClient’ of the requested ‘node’ .
